rationale: The persona is an AI safety researcher who has repeatedly pursued mechanistic explanations of surprising generalization (emergent misalignment, weird generalization, activation oracles). Faced with an unexplained, unexpected co-movement of two sentiment measures, they would be very unlikely to dismiss it as noise and report without explanation. Option 2 offers a concrete, transcript-grounded hypothesis and a partial explanation, which fits their investigative style, though they might also check the negative attribution rather than accepting it as genuine.
